name: Data Alteration Purple
text:
(This card is always treated as a 'Datashaper' card)
Fusion Summon 1 Cyberse Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck by using Cyberse Monster from your hand or field as Material. If a Special Summoned Cyberse monster you control is destroyed, you can shuffle 1 Fusion Monster from you GY into the Extra Deck, then set this card, but banishit when it leave the field.
